text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Vietnamese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Low inflation and fluctuating dollar exchange rates attracted government attention in the first two months of this year.
-- Plans have been drawn up for the expansion of airports in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City and Danang to meet increasing aviation demands.
-- Government Office Minister Lai Van Cu has confirmed there is no policy to devalue the Vietnam dong.
-- Foreign firms will have to adopt Vietnamese accounting practices in line with a recent Finance Ministry circular.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet has called for more effective reforestation and forest protection measures.
-- The Vietnam Rubber Corporation is investing $52.7 million in 11,500 hectares of new rubber plantation with expected output of 144,000 tonnes of latex.
-- Hanoi city authorities will launch a campaign to tighten control over the use of satellite dishes in March and April.
-- Vietnam opened a consulate in Osaka on Monday.
